entries.clue: Noble who flings her howling baby at Alice and finds a moral in everything
Tight-packed block or roll of dried grass, dropped in the field by machine
Four in the afternoon, when broiling for dinner begins, says Humpty Dumpty
The ram's mate, and mother to every new arrival in the fold
White blooms three gardeners frantically daub red before the Queen arrives
All the cattle on one farm, moving as one body down the lane at dusk
Tall sealed cylinder on the skyline, holding fermented winter feed
It described the sword that went snicker-snack through the Jabberwock
Pivoted blades kept for cloth alone, never lent out for paper
Matted woollen sheet, made without weaving, that will not fray at a cut edge
Yard bird that scratches for grit and leaves a warm egg in her nest box
Fold pressed into a fabric to give fullness, as down a school skirt
